page: Microsoft Azure E32ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz across 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs (2 threads per core). It provides 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU ratio, alongside a bundled 1888 GB local NVMe SSD. The processor architecture is x86_64 and features 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache per core cluster, with hardware vector extensions including AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16, while lacking dedicated GPUs.

Benchmark data demonstrates strong single-core CPU throughput, reaching 3079.96 in stress-ng and 1980.0 in Geekbench. Multi-core performance is robust, producing a Geekbench multi-core score of 16104.0, while PassMark tests show top-quartile cryptographic performance at 38619.67 alongside an overall PassMark CPU score of 46704.6. Memory subsystem performance is strong with a 2758.74 PassMark memory score and uncached large-block read throughput of 75.65 GB/sec. For lightweight machine learning inference on a 135M model, the instance achieves 341.89 tokens/sec for text generation and 2755.25 tokens/sec for prompt processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E32ads_v6 packs high memory density and extensive fast local NVMe capacity into a single VM, eliminating the immediate necessity for separate external block storage for scratch space or temporary caches. However, workloads scaling beyond 7B LLM parameter models show typical CPU execution bounds, reflecting average throughput tiers compared to specialized GPU instances.

The Azure E32ads_v6 is particularly suited for in-memory databases, large-scale caching services like Redis, enterprise transactional databases, and data-intensive batch processing. Its combination of 256 GB RAM, fast single-thread capability, and high-capacity local NVMe storage matches the requirements of large analytics platforms and enterprise backend systems.
description: Microsoft Azure E32ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine configured with 32 vCPUs and 16 physical cores on a 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture with Hyper-V virtualization, it includes 256.0 GB of RAM (yielding an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio) and a dedicated 1888 GB local NVMe SSD, without attached GPUs. Benchmark evaluations show strong single-core execution (1980.0 Geekbench, 3079.96 stress-ng) and top-quartile PassMark memory and cryptographic performance. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 75.65 GB/sec, while multi-threaded decompression hits 180.46 GB/sec. The instance delivers high resource density for workloads demanding high memory pools and rapid ephemeral disk operations, making it suitable for in-memory databases, distributed caches, data processing pipelines, and enterprise relational database engines.
